label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common) following an unrewarded previous trial, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition (in_action=1, in_state=1; 100% of activations). It never fires at D1/GO, after a2, or after rare transitions. Within a1->S1 D2 steps it strongly prefers trials whose previous trial was unrewarded (92% of mass) and late episodes (no activity before trial ~25, peaks at trials 60-89, drops in 90-99). The predicate gets dev F1 0.59 with mass recall 0.91 and covers 99% of top-quartile activations. Precision is limited (0.47): many matching steps look identical in the rendered windows but stay silent, so some continuous hidden-state factor gates it. Restricting to trials 50-89 raises F1 to 0.65, and adding policy logit < 3 raises precision to 0.68 but lowers recall. All variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & last=a1 S1 u (+3.19), phase=D2 & this=a1 S1 (+3.12), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+1.85), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (+1.82), phase=D2 & ep_dec=4 (+1.75), phase=D2 & last=a2 S2 u (+1.71).
